scope: Visible Apple Music library playlist artwork repair
behavior: Keep existing MusicKit library playlist IDs, row order, selection and playback identity.
Only visible rows with missing or exhausted artwork request optional enrichment, in batches of at most eight and one in flight.
Match returned artwork only by exact library ID. Catalog cover fallback requires an unambiguous explicit catalog identity supplied by Apple.
Keep at most 128 cover entries in memory; per-item weak marks prevent automatic retry loops without retaining historical playlist IDs.
A later viewability event is serviced after the current batch settles; completion alone does not scan the rest of the library.
The entire optional provider read has one 12-second caller deadline, including presenter/token waits. Retired preflight never dispatches a later artwork operation.
Native caller cancellation/deadline returns without awaiting a stalled transport. The single raw transport slot remains owned until actual settlement; late retired results never cache.
Connection revisions and source/list/close guards reject retired results. Older native clients and optional lookup failures preserve browsing with placeholders.
limits: Automated Swift checks use a fake transport and make no Apple Music account requests.
A fresh native build is required because this adds an Expo native bridge method and Swift helper.
Actual recovery of the owner’s library playlist covers remains to be checked on the fresh physical iPhone candidate.
This change does not restore automatic song changes at workout round boundaries; the production timed-music flag is unchanged.
